title: The Chess Pieces’ Day at the Beach
description: On their midsummer day off, the chess pieces leave the board for the beach. The pawn is the first to reach the water.
alt: A walnut knight and pale wooden rook stand beside beach towels. A trail of round impressions in the sand leads from the chessboard to a pawn at the water’s edge.
pairing: A midsummer seaside holiday × chess pieces stepping off the board
